Home›Six-week groups›The Quiet Hour
Six-week group for anxiety, low mood or stress

Calm,and the same every week.

The Quiet Hour is for anyone living with anxiety, low mood or stress. It's the same simple routine at the same times every week, so nothing comes as a surprise. Low lights in the studio, low music, nobody watching, and you can leave whenever you need to.

Book your placeCompare all groups

Starts Monday 9 November. Or text Helen on 07718 339510

Is this for you?

  • Walking into a gym or a busy class feels like too much
  • You'd like to know exactly what will happen before you arrive
  • You find gentle movement and breathing help you settle
  • You'd like to be around people without having to talk

A six-week group

The Quiet Hour is one of our six-week groups. It meets twice a week, once downstairs in the gym and once upstairs in the studio, with up to 8 people so Helen gets to know everyone. It runs in six-week cycles all year: the next starts Monday 9 November, and the one after that in the week of 11 January 2027. When your six weeks are up, you can carry on into the next cycle or move into any class on our regular timetable.

Mondays at 7:30pm and Wednesdays at 8pm£50 for six weeks
Book your place

Can't make this cycle? Leave your details for the next one.

What happens in a session

Downstairs, in the gym

Gentle strength

  • Arrive and plan. Helen explains the same plan as every week
  • Warm-up. Slow, simple movement
  • Simple circuit. The same five moves, at your own pace
  • Slow stretch. Easing out
  • Breathe. Settling before heading home
45 minutesUnheated
Upstairs, in the studio

Gentle yoga

  • Arrive and plan. Low lights, tea, and the plan for tonight
  • Grounding. Simple breathing and slow movement
  • Slow flow. The same gentle sequence each week
  • Supported stretches. Long holds, inspired by Yin
  • Rest. Eyes open if you prefer
60 minutesUnheated

Questions

What if I need to leave halfway through?

That's absolutely fine. Sit near the door if it helps, and leave whenever you need to. Nobody will ask why.

Do I have to talk to anyone?

No. You're welcome to arrive, take part and go home without chatting.

Do I have to phone?

No. You can book online, or send Helen a text and she'll reply by text.

Is this therapy?

No. It's gentle exercise in a calm setting, and it doesn't replace any support you already have. If you're struggling, please also talk to your GP.

When are the sessions?

Mondays at 7:30pm and Wednesdays at 8pm, starting Monday 9 November. The six weeks finish on Wednesday 16 December.

Is it a one-off?

No. The groups run in six-week cycles all year. The next cycle starts Monday 9 November, and the one after that in the week of 11 January 2027. You can join at the start of any cycle, and carry on from one to the next.

How do I join?

Book and pay online through our booking system, Gymcatch. You can use the app or book straight from your browser. If you'd like to ask a question first, text Helen on 07718 339510 and she'll get back to you.
